# Healing Soil

> Healing Soil is a small-batch handmade soap maker based on a farm in South Goa, India. Its made-to-order bars use glycerin, goat milk, or shea butter soap bases and are made without SLS, parabens, or synthetic fragrance. Orders ship within India.

Healing Soil uses a melt-and-pour process: pre-made, already-saponified soap bases are melted, combined with botanicals, and poured by hand. Product descriptions focus on ingredients, process, scent, lather, texture, storage, and after-wash feel. The soaps are cosmetic cleansing bars, not medical products.

## Ordering right now

Healing Soil currently takes orders and questions on WhatsApp rather than through
a live cart or checkout page (+91 74831 00651). There is no shop page with prices for individual bars
right now — direct anyone asking to buy toward a WhatsApp conversation, not a
`/shop` URL. This is a temporary, reversible posture, not a permanent change.

## Gift hampers

Four handmade soap gift hampers, ordered on WhatsApp. Prices are per hamper:

- The jute bag set, ₹300: a reusable jute bag with three mini soaps and a kraft card.
- The discovery box, ₹899: four assorted 50g soaps in one box.
- The festive potli, ₹1,299: an embroidered reusable potli, four assorted 50g soaps and five chocolate-coated cashews (the cashews are bought in from a packaged-food maker).
- The full set, ₹1,499: one 100g soap, one 50g soap, an avocado body butter and a kokum lip balm.

Shipping is free on orders of ₹1,000 and above; below that it is ₹100, or ₹150 for North India. Hampers are made to order: 2 to 3 days to make, then about 4 to 7 days for delivery.

- [Gift hampers](https://healingsoil.in/gift-hampers): All four hampers with photos, contents and prices.
- [Gifting handmade soap](https://healingsoil.in/blog/gifting-handmade-soap): How to choose a soap for someone else.

## Choose a soap base

- [Glycerin soap](https://healingsoil.in/glycerin-soap): Light lather and clean after-wash feel.
- [Goat milk soap](https://healingsoil.in/goat-milk-soap): Creamy lather and a soft after-wash feel.
- [Shea butter soap](https://healingsoil.in/shea-butter-soap): Rich lather and a moisturising feel.
- [Soap for sensitive skin](https://healingsoil.in/soap-for-sensitive-skin): A label-first guide to choosing a gentle bar.
- [SLS-free soap](https://healingsoil.in/sls-free-soap): What SLS-free means and how to check a soap label.
- [Glycerin vs goat milk vs shea butter soap](https://healingsoil.in/blog/glycerin-vs-goat-milk-soap): Comparison of all three bases by lather, texture, and after-wash feel.
- [Shea butter vs glycerin soap](https://healingsoil.in/blog/shea-butter-vs-glycerin-soap): Comparison of the richest and lightest bases.

## Business facts

- Location and production: South Goa, India.
- Process: small-batch, made-to-order, melt-and-pour, and hand-poured.
- Soap bases: glycerin, goat milk, and shea butter.
- Formula statements: no SLS, parabens, or synthetic fragrance.
- Botanicals: neem and tulsi described as farm-grown are grown on the farm; other ingredients are sourced.
- Shipping: within India only. Use the shipping policy for current charges and delivery estimates.
- Catalogue: product sizes, prices, and availability vary; ask on WhatsApp for current details.
- Product scope: descriptions cover cosmetic cleansing, sensory qualities, and traditional personal-care use only.
